description: Every Fearless Android build distributed as jp.co.soramitsu.fearless (GitHub release assets and Play-only tags), the Room schema version it leaves on a device, and the fixture that reproduces that schema for AllReleasedSchemasUpgradeTest. APKs are not committed: fetch_release_apks.sh downloads them into a local cache and checks every sha256 pinned here.

signers.cc17cbd4304322c58e27890345e6009b2817b77e: Google Play app signing (CN=Android, Google Inc.); the -google/Play builds 1.9.14-3.7.4
